title: Pocketwave retail integration play diary
content:
Quick personal play-diary for Pocketwave retail pilot - raw notes, questions, and next steps. Treat as scratchpad.

Call summary (2025-02-12):
- Attendees: Sam (Pocketwave CTO), Priya (SRE lead), Marco (product), Aisha, Jon.
- Use-case: in-store assistant for associates and a post-purchase returns assistant. Max latency target for associate flow: 250ms p95 for single-turn SKU lookups; conversational flows can tolerate 700ms p95.
- Data concerns: PII in free-text returns descriptions; legal wants egress to be limited (no model calls outside VPC) and audit logs retained 1 year.
- Volume estimate: pilot 10 stores, ~1k requests/day, peak 5 TPS per store during promo.

Notes / gotchas observed in call:
- They currently use a proprietary search index for skus; need embeddings for semantic SKU match to map fuzzy descriptions. Embedding dimension preference: 1536-ish? (they use older vector DB that prefers 512 — mismatch)
- On-prem gateway team wants TLS mutual auth to our private control plane. Confirm Redwood Private supports mTLS + KMS integration for keys.
- Marco asks about fallback on outages -> want deterministic canned responses + ticket creation to ServiceNow.
- Priya: "we can't store raw customer notes in our DB, redact before sending" -> need client-side redaction + tokenization guidance.

Technical checklist (initial):
- Confirm model variant with good small-context retrieval + fast embed: recommend r-instruct-medium-int8 (note: benchmarking needed).
- Plan: prefix caching of SKU list (~20k products) on gateway vs server-side; evaluate prefix/KV cache size on dedicated nodes.
- Batching: associate flow is low-latency single requests; disable large batching. Use minibatching for async analytics path.
- Network: VPC peering + Private CP. Need to draft network diagram for Pocketwave infra team.
- Auth: OIDC federation with Pocketwave IdP -> map to team roles for rate limits and audit.

Prompt & eval notes:
- Quick prompt prototype for returns triage included (sketch below). Need to produce gold responses for 50 prompt cases (they will provide).
  Prompt sketch: "You are Returns Assistant. Customer message: <<MSG>>. Extract reason, item SKU (fuzzy), suggested policy outcome, required followup tasks. Redact PII."
- Add a step for confidence scoring and a rule to escalate if confidence < 0.6.

Operational SLOs / Metrics to present:
- p50/p95 latency (associate flow and conversational flow), tokens per request distribution, cost per 1k requests, embed lookups per day, cache hit ratio, accuracy of SKU mapping (top1/top3).
- Alerting: model fallback rate >1% over 5m, slow p95 > target for 3 consecutive 5m windows.

Security / compliance asks:
- KMS/HSM options for key storage, and requirement: customer-managed key (CMK) mandatory for pilot.
- Data residency: pilot must run in us-central1 region.
- Audit logs: retention 1 year, export to their SIEM (use S3-compatible endpoint).

Immediate next steps (action items):
- Aisha: send network diagram template and ask for CIDR ranges (due 2025-02-16).
- Jon: spin up a quick embed eval runner using their sample SKU csv (Jon to request CSV from Marco) and test Redwood embeddings vs open alternatives (due 2025-02-20).
- Leah: draft privacy-redaction patterns and a lightweight client-side filter snippet (JS/Python) to remove emails/phones before sending (due 2025-02-18).
- Sam (Pocketwave): provide 50 golden examples for returns intents + SKU fuzzies and the SKU master CSV (due 2025-02-19).

Questions to surface / unresolved:
- Can we meet 250ms p95 with Private deployment on their instance types? Need perf runbook and a quick perf test plan.
- How many SKU embedding lookups per second do they expect at peak across stores? Clarify caching TTL requirements.
- Legal: confirm allowed fields in logs (redacted vs hashed tokens).

Rough cost sketch (ballpark for pilot):
- Private deployment (single small cluster): $7k/mo platform + infra (estimate) + embedding/usage tokens ~ $200-800/mo depending on traffic and model. Need finance ops to build an official quote.

Prompt tests to create (for evaluation repo):
- 10 fuzzy SKU mapping cases (typos, synonyms, category descriptions).
- 10 returns reason classification (worn/damaged/other).
- 10 policy-route decisions (refund/store-credit/exchange).
- 10 PII redaction edge cases.
- 10 multi-turn followups (customer clarifies).

Notes to self:
- Keep the first pilot model conservative (smaller quantized model) to reduce cost and meet latency. If accuracy struggles, plan a canary to upgrade to larger model and route premium tier.
- Save bandwidth by returning only decision + ticket id to associate UI; do full transcript for analytics pipeline off-band.

Meeting follow-up email draft (copy + paste):
"Thanks again for the intro call. Attached: network diagram template, privacy-redaction snippet draft, and our initial playbook. Jon will start the embed runner once we get the SKU CSV. Can Sam confirm the 50 golden examples by Tue? We'll aim to have a small Private pilot in us-central1 by end of Feb if infra checks out.

Quick ask: please share CIDR and preferred KMS vendor so we can validate the VPC peering steps.

— Aisha"

Random scratch bullets:
- test latency w/ tcpdump vs our observability hooks (to rule out client-side jitter)
- consider a cheap LRU cache at gateway if prefix caching doesn't hit enough
- fallbacks: small rule-based SKU lookup using normalized UPC if embedding fails

End of scratchpad. Keep iterative notes here.
